figurative_meaning_bn: দুই বলশালী, স্থূলকায় ও প্রবল প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী/প্রতিপক্ষ
figurative_meaning_en: Two powerful, stout-bodied and formidable rivals or opponents
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাজনীতিতে দুই দল গজকচ্ছপের মতো লড়াই করছে।
ব্যবসায়িক প্রতিযোগিতায় তারা গজকচ্ছপের সমান শক্তিশালী প্রতিপক্ষ।
example_sentences_in_english: In politics, the two parties are fighting like an elephant and a tortoise.
In business competition, they are formidable rivals akin to an elephant and a tortoise.
history: Derived from folklore tales depicting the fierce battle between an elephant and a tortoise, symbolizing intense rivalry between unlikely strong opponents, possibly inspired by ancient Indian fables like those in Panchatantra.
note: The idiom highlights the unexpected intensity of conflict between two powerful entities of different natures.
